references.label: Top-center 2x lane
references.description: Top lane that lights 2x for the Collect Bonus saucer.

references.label: Left orbit
references.description: Repeatable shot to the top lanes that also advances base bonus.

references.label: Three center saucers
references.description: Center cove that cycles awards including 3x end-of-ball bonus and the right-side post.

references.label: Upper-right Collect Bonus saucer
references.description: Hole that collects the base bonus at up to 2x and resets it to 10,000.

references.label: Right-side post
references.description: Raised post that can block some balls from the right outlane.
